adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 37.1. The target week has a 5.6% price increase to $13.38, with no events. Recent weeks show a strong trend: sales rose from 19 to 49 units over 4 weeks at the new price, with a 2026-03-30 Easter week spike (30 units, x1.08 vs baseline). The 2026-04-06 week (49 units, x1.32 vs baseline) shows a lift consistent with the higher price. Past promotions have noise-adjusted effects near 1.0, but the current price increase is deeper than prior promotions and coincides with rising seasonal demand. The price hike likely suppresses demand, but the observed lift suggests a net positive effect. The classical model misses this, as it doesn't account for the sustained post-price lift. A conservative adjustment is warranted.

It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-84% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
